proof_body:
by
  intro α _ μ f g p q hpq hf hg
  haveI : (ENNReal.ofReal p).HolderTriple (ENNReal.ofReal q) 1 := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    have hp := hpq.pos
    have hq := hpq.symm.pos
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hp, ← ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hq, ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity), hpq.inv_add_inv_eq_inv]
    simp
  have h1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (f * g) μ := hf.integrable_mul hg
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  have h2 := MeasureTheory.integral_mul_norm_le_Lp_mul_Lq (μ := μ) hpq hf hg
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h2
  calc |∫ a, f a * g a ∂μ| ≤ ∫ a, |f a * g a| ∂μ := MeasureTheory.abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ = ∫ a, |f a| * |g a| ∂μ := by simp_rw [abs_mul]
    _ ≤ _ := h2
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (f g : α → ℝ) (p q : ℝ), p.HolderConjugate q → MeasureTheory.MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ → MeasureTheory.MemLp g (ENNReal.ofReal q) μ → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun a => f a * g a) μ ∧ |∫ a, f a * g a ∂μ| ≤ (∫ a, |f a| ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) * (∫ a, |g a| ^ q ∂μ) ^ (1 / q)
